notes.title: Small Rebalance Patch
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes

Toned down damage values of both bosses.

Player attacks and dodges consume less stamina.



Bug Fixes

Pitchfork enemy no longer runs in place after attacking.

Grapple hook no longer despawns if thrown too close to an enemy.

notes.title: Demo - Info and Release Window
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481073/918007cdb582828a9e48654a89ee467efdf49f9c.png

Cerulean Singe is approaching the point of having a demo!

Some information leading up to the release:

- The demo is planned to be released in Q1 2025.

- It will feature the first full level of the game.

- It will include two polished multi-phase boss fights.

The demo is in the later stage of polish with most of the mechanics and events complete. Pretty much all that is left is optimization, bug fixing, and playtesting.

Wishlist to get notified when the demo releases!
